name: Omdrid
description: Omdrid was a planet that occupied the seventh orbit around the star Beheboth. It was the outermost celestial body in the Beheboth system, a star system that was located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors in the Outer Rim Territories. Like its inner neighbor Derenath, Omdrid was classified as an ice planet and had no moons.
